name: Shoulder CARs
cues: Squeeze a fist and brace your core
Draw the biggest slow circle you can
Only the shoulder moves, ribs stay down
cautions: Go slowly; skip any part of the circle that pinches

name: Cable external rotation (arm at side)
cues: Pulley at elbow height, stand side-on
Rolled towel between elbow and ribs
Rotate out slowly, 3 seconds back
cautions: Use the lightest plate; this is control work, not strength

name: Cable internal rotation (arm at side)
cues: Pulley at elbow height, cable coming from the outside
Elbow pinned to your side
Rotate the hand toward your belly
cautions: Keep the shoulder from rolling forward at the end

name: Cable 90/90 external rotation
cues: Upper arm at shoulder height, elbow at 90°
Rotate the forearm up and back without arching
Pause 1 second at the top
cautions: Very light load; stop if you feel pinching at the front of the shoulder

name: Side-lying dumbbell external rotation
cues: Lie on your side, top elbow on a rolled towel at your hip
Rotate the dumbbell up toward the ceiling
Lower over 3 seconds
cautions: Start with 1–4 kg

name: Sleeper stretch
cues: Lie on the side being stretched, arm at 90° in front
Roll your body back slightly
Gently press the forearm toward the floor
cautions: Very gentle pressure; stop on any pain at the front of the shoulder

name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cues: Pull the arm across your chest at the elbow
Keep the shoulder blade down and back
Feel it at the back of the shoulder
cautions: Don't shrug the shoulder toward the ear

name: Cable face pull with external rotation
cues: Rope at forehead height
Pull toward your face, elbows high
Finish with hands rotated back beside your ears
cautions: Light enough to hold the finish for 1 second

name: Dumbbell Cuban press
cues: Upright row to elbows at shoulder height
Rotate forearms up to vertical
Press overhead, then reverse
cautions: Very light dumbbells (1–5 kg); skip if the upright row pinches

name: Kettlebell arm bar
cues: Press a light kettlebell up while on your back
Roll onto your side away from it, top leg crossing over
Eyes on the bell, arm locked vertical
cautions: Start very light (4–8 kg) and keep the wrist straight

name: Foam roller thoracic extension
cues: Roller across the upper back, hands support the head
Keep hips down, extend over the roller
Move the roller up one segment and repeat
cautions: Stay on the upper/mid back, never the lower back or neck

name: Open book rotation
cues: Side-lying, knees bent at 90°, arms straight in front
Open the top arm across, following it with your eyes
Keep the knees stacked
cautions: Let the arm drop only as far as it goes without strain

name: Thread the needle
cues: On hands and knees
Reach one arm up to the ceiling, then thread it under the other arm
Hips stay over the knees
cautions: Keep weight off the neck

name: Bench lat & triceps stretch
cues: Kneel facing a bench, elbows on the edge, palms together
Sit the hips back and drop the chest
Bend the elbows to bring hands behind the head
cautions: Don't force the lower back into an arch

name: Wall slides
cues: Back, head and forearms on the wall
Slide arms up while keeping contact
Ribs down, no lower-back arch
cautions: Only go as high as you can keep contact

name: Incline bench prone Y-T-W
cues: Chest on an incline bench at ~30°
Raise arms into Y, then T, then W = 1 rep
Thumbs up, shoulder blades back and down
cautions: Bodyweight or 1–2 kg is plenty

name: Dead hang
cues: Overhand grip, shoulder width
Relax and let the shoulders rise toward the ears
Breathe slowly; feet can touch a box for support
cautions: Step down rather than drop; skip with an acute shoulder injury

name: Scapular pull-ups
cues: From a dead hang, keep arms straight
Pull the shoulder blades down and together
Lower slowly back to a full hang
cautions: Keep the elbows straight; it's a small movement

name: Hip CARs
cues: Hold a wall or rack for balance
Knee up, open out to the side, rotate back and down
Pelvis stays still, move slowly
cautions: Can also be done on hands and knees if balance is hard

name: 90/90 hip switches
cues: Sit with both knees bent at 90°, one in front, one to the side
Rotate both knees to the other side
Use hands behind you at first, then go hands-free
cautions: Move within a comfortable range; knees should feel no strain

name: 90/90 internal rotation lift-offs
cues: In 90/90, sit tall
Lift the back foot and knee off the floor
Hold 2 seconds, lower with control
cautions: Expect a small range at first; cramping is normal, pain is not

name: Couch stretch
cues: Back knee on a mat, shin up against a bench
Squeeze the glute of the back leg
Stay upright, tuck the pelvis slightly
cautions: Pad the knee; ease off if the front of the knee hurts

name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch with reach
cues: Half-kneeling, tuck the tailbone
Squeeze the back glute and shift forward slightly
Reach the same-side arm overhead and away
cautions: Don't arch the lower back to go deeper

name: Bench figure-4 (pigeon) stretch
cues: Place the shin across a bench, knee out to the side
Long spine, hinge forward from the hips
Breathe into the outer hip
cautions: Lower the bench height or use a box if the knee complains

name: Goblet squat pry
cues: Hold a kettlebell at the chest and sit into a deep squat
Use elbows to push the knees out
Shift side to side gently
cautions: Heels down; elevate heels on a small plate if needed

name: Assisted deep squat hold
cues: Hold a rack or cable column for support
Sit as deep as possible, chest up
Relax and breathe
cautions: Use support so you can relax into the position

name: Cossack squat
cues: Wide stance, shift onto one leg and sit down
Other leg straight, toes up
Hold a light kettlebell as a counterweight once comfortable
cautions: Only go as deep as you can with the working heel down

name: Adductor rock-back
cues: On hands and knees, extend one leg straight out to the side
Rock the hips back toward the heels
Keep the back flat
cautions: Pad the knee on the mat

name: Cable standing hip abduction
cues: Ankle strap on the outside leg, pulley low
Lift the leg out to the side, toes forward
Don't lean the torso
cautions: Light load, slow tempo

name: World's greatest stretch
cues: Deep lunge, same-side hand inside the front foot
Drop the elbow toward the instep
Rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling
cautions: Keep the back knee down for an easier version

name: Cat-cow
cues: On hands and knees
Round the spine segment by segment, then arch
Move with the breath
cautions: Keep it slow and pain-free

name: Knee-to-wall ankle mobilisation
cues: Half-kneeling facing a wall, front foot a hand's width away
Drive the knee over the toes to touch the wall
Heel stays down
cautions: Move the foot closer if the heel lifts

name: Copenhagen plank (short lever)
cues: Side plank with the top knee resting on a bench
Lift the hips into a straight line
Bottom leg can hover or rest
cautions: Short lever (knee on bench) first; stop on groin pain
